<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Included since Arcantry 0.3.0</span><code>$forge-skill-from-conversations</code></p>

Turn recurring work found in supplied, current, or recent completed Codex conversations into one focused, evaluated skill candidate. Use only when explicitly invoked with $forge-skill-from-conversations. Orchestrate evidence capture, candidate approval, skill creation, held-out evaluation, and optional adoption without auto-approving, auto-installing, publishing, committing, or pushing anything.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link forge-skill-from-conversations
```

## Examples

### Create a skill from recent work

**Prompt**

> Use $forge-skill-from-conversations on these selected completed tasks and propose one reusable skill candidate.

**Expected outcome**

One evidence-backed candidate, a stop for approval, an isolated implementation, and held-out evaluation before adoption.

### Use supplied conversation evidence

**Prompt**

> Use $forge-skill-from-conversations on this transcript. Do not scan other tasks or install anything without asking.

**Expected outcome**

A privacy-scoped skill-forging flow that preserves separate approval for the candidate and its installation.
